key: Would you like to purchase a ticket? \ch[321,-1,Grandview Station,Goldenrod Station,Sunset Station,Heatherhill Station,Peony Station,Kingsbury Station,Shantyport Station]
en: Would you like to purchase a ticket? \ch[321,-1,Grandview Station,Goldenrod Station,Sunset Station,Heatherhill Station,Peony Station,Kingsbury Station,Shantyport Station]
ja: チケットを購入しますか? \ch[321,-1,グランドビュー駅,コガネ駅,サンセット駅,ヘザーヒル駅,ピオニー駅,キングスベリー駅,シャンティポート駅]

key: 'Sup. It's nice for me to be able to easily visit my sister now.
en: 'Sup. It's nice for me to be able to easily visit my sister now.
ja: よう。これで気軽に妹に会いに行けるようになったな。

key: Er, not that she wasn't worth the trip before.
en: Er, not that she wasn't worth the trip before.
ja: いや、前だって会いに行く価値がなかったってわけじゃねえけど。

key: Aside from when everyone is coming to or leaving school, I really like hanging out down here. It's so temperate compared to the upper floors!
en: Aside from when everyone is coming to or leaving school, I really like hanging out down here. It's so temperate compared to the upper floors!
ja: みんなが通学や下校で混む時間帯を除けば、ここでのんびりするのは結構好きなんだ。上の階に比べてずっと過ごしやすいし!

key: Tch, I gotta finish this work before I go home... I'm gonna miss my train at this rate.
en: Tch, I gotta finish this work before I go home... I'm gonna miss my train at this rate.
ja: ちっ、帰る前にこの仕事を終わらせないと……このままじゃ電車に乗り遅れる。

key: I ain't touchin' those stinkin' city shelters.
en: I ain't touchin' those stinkin' city shelters.
ja: あのくっせえ市の避難所なんかには近づかねえよ。

key: They're probably full up anyway. But I'll tell you what.
en: They're probably full up anyway. But I'll tell you what.
ja: どうせ満室だろうしな。でも聞いてくれよ。

key: The seats on these shuttles are somethin' comfy! I'll live there!
en: The seats on these shuttles are somethin' comfy! I'll live there!
ja: このシャトルの座席、結構座り心地いいんだよな! ここに住んじまおうかな!

key: LUMI: \PN, you waited for me!
en: LUMI: \PN, you waited for me!
ja: ルミ: \PN、待っててくれたの!

key: LUMI: Thanks for coming to pick me up!
en: LUMI: Thanks for coming to pick me up!
ja: ルミ: 迎えに来てくれてありがとう!

key: Sorry it took so long--
en: Sorry it took so long--
ja: 遅くなってごめんね――

key: I stayed after to ask the teacher a question, and then I made friends with a kid named Princerella--
en: I stayed after to ask the teacher a question, and then I made friends with a kid named Princerella--
ja: 先生に質問するために残ってて、それでプリンセレラって子と友達になったの――

key: Which, like, WOW, just saying--
en: Which, like, WOW, just saying--
ja: それがもう、すっごいの、ほんとに――

key: So they and I are gonna eat lunch together tomorrow!
en: So they and I are gonna eat lunch together tomorrow!
ja: 明日、一緒にお昼ご飯を食べる約束をしたんだ!

key: Anyway, Eve had a sudden emergency at the clinic,
en: Anyway, Eve had a sudden emergency at the clinic,
ja: それで、イヴが診療所で急な用事ができちゃって、

key: And sometimes Noel comes by but he had another challenger.
en: And sometimes Noel comes by but he had another challenger.
ja: たまにノエルが来てくれるんだけど、今日は別の挑戦者がいたみたいで。

key: And I know I COULD walk home on my own, but that's no fun.
en: And I know I COULD walk home on my own, but that's no fun.
ja: 一人で歩いて帰ることもできるんだけど、それじゃつまらないもん。

key: I was gonna invite Princerella with us too but they said their mom is really picky about when they get back.
en: I was gonna invite Princerella with us too but they said their mom is really picky about when they get back.
ja: プリンセレラも誘おうとしたんだけど、帰る時間にお母さんがすごくうるさいんだって。

key: I know it's annoying, but that doesn't sound so bad to me.
en: I know it's annoying, but that doesn't sound so bad to me.
ja: 面倒だとは思うけど、わたしはそんなに悪いことだとは思わないな。

key: Actually, I think a lot of the other students take going here for granted?
en: Actually, I think a lot of the other students take going here for granted?
ja: 実は、他の生徒の多くはここに通えることを、当たり前だと思ってる気がするの。

key: Like not just because it's a good school, but it seems like everyone can't wait for their classes to end.
en: Like not just because it's a good school, but it seems like everyone can't wait for their classes to end.
ja: 良い学校だからってだけじゃなくて、みんな授業が終わるのを待ちきれないみたいなんだよね。

key: And I know it might just be because it's novel, but I think it's fun to learn in a group and always have someone to work on things with!
en: And I know it might just be because it's novel, but I think it's fun to learn in a group and always have someone to work on things with!
ja: まだ新鮮だからかもしれないけど、みんなで学んで、いつも一緒に取り組める人がいるのって、楽しいと思うな!

key: I'm really, really glad I could enroll here!
en: I'm really, really glad I could enroll here!
ja: ここに通えるようになって、本当に本当にうれしいの!

key: Would you thank Ms. Florinia for pulling the strings for me again?
en: Would you thank Ms. Florinia for pulling the strings for me again?
ja: フロリニア先生にまた口をきいてくれたこと、お礼を言っておいてくれる?

key: Actually, I'll just write her a thank you note myself!
en: Actually, I'll just write her a thank you note myself!
ja: ううん、やっぱり自分でお礼の手紙を書くね!

key: LUMI: Oh, looks like it's time to go!
en: LUMI: Oh, looks like it's time to go!
ja: ルミ: あ、そろそろ行く時間みたい!

key: LUMI: I've got an essay to write when we get home already,
en: LUMI: I've got an essay to write when we get home already,
ja: ルミ: 家に帰ったら、もう作文を書かなきゃいけないの、

key: And I gotta say, taking it for granted or not, I'm not sold on the whole 'homework' thing.
en: And I gotta say, taking it for granted or not, I'm not sold on the whole 'homework' thing.
ja: 当たり前だろうとなんだろうと、正直「宿題」ってやつにはいまいち納得いってないんだよね。

key: LUMI: It's okay though, I'll get through it!
en: LUMI: It's okay though, I'll get through it!
ja: ルミ: でも大丈夫、ちゃんとやりきるから!

key: As soon as I get home, I'm gonna go all 'chill beats to study to' on it!
en: As soon as I get home, I'm gonna go all 'chill beats to study to' on it!
ja: 家に着いたらすぐ、「勉強がはかどるチルなビート」でも流しながらやるつもり!
